The *Nisabhattheragāthā* (Thag 2.38) is a short poetic text in the *Theragāthā*, belonging to the *Dukanipāta* of the Pali Canon's Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. The verses are attributed to the elder (thera) Nisabha. SuttaCentral records nine translations of the poem across eight languages, including an English translation by Bhikkhu Sujato [SuttaCentral].
